text: {"score":4,"justification":"The summary is accurate and cautious, with numbers that match the card: 24.1% vs 3.4%, score 5.91, z 2.95, 37% low-complexity, 16 documented claims, 4 documented 99215s, and 0 of 10 data-reviewed mismatches.
